title: stackfoundry ecosystems (.stackfoundry/ecosystems.json)
description: Every version pin in the repo, grouped by ecosystem, with how to discover updates, apply them and gate them. check-updates runs only the `discover` commands; bump runs the rest.

deferredFile.description: The deferred-upgrades tracker, relative to the repo root.

ecosystems.description: In apply order: platforms first (a runtime major changes what packages may be), then package managers, then generators, CI, infrastructure, and format migrations last.

id.description: Short name used as `bump <id>` (nuget, web-npm, actions, dotnet-platform…).

pack.description: The pack whose upgrade notes apply.

file.description: Path or glob of the pinned file.

anchor.description: How to find the pin inside it (a key path, a grep pattern).

discover.description: Read-only commands that list outdated, vulnerable and deprecated items. Must not write to the tree. For kind `formats` this is `["check-formats --report-only"]`: check-updates runs that skill's two passes instead of commands.

apply.description: How a version is changed (edit a file, a package-manager command).

afterApply.description: Commands that must follow an edit (regenerate lock files, run a codemod).

gateTargets.description: Targets whose gate must pass after a bump here.

chains.description: Lock-step chains: pins that must move together.

members.description: file + anchor of every pin in the chain.

outsideManifest.description: Pins the discover commands cannot see (projects outside the solution, inline versions); checked by hand.

sources.description: Release notes and migration guides to read for a major.

traps.description: What has bitten here before (with the evidence).
